name: B10-0509/2025 (The Left) – Escalating repression of the Baha’is in Iran
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalating repression of the Baha’is in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for full respect for the rights of religious and ethnic minorities in Iran, including the Baha'is, who are not recognised in the Iranian constitution. It condemns intolerance and the rise in executions, and repeats its opposition to the death penalty worldwide. It also asks the European Union to lift sanctions on Iran that harm ordinary people's rights and living conditions, and criticises double standards in how human rights concerns are applied to different countries.

- The text is an opinion; no law changes. It asks the EU to lift some sanctions on Iran.
- It affects Iran's minorities, especially Baha'is, and all Iranians hit by sanctions.
- Next, the resolution is sent to EU institutions, member states and Iranian authorities.
